notes.title: UPDATE v1.09 released!
notes.content:
[b]Here are the patch notes(v1.09.372):[/b]
[list]
[*] NEW FEATURE* - 4 starting conditions in "Create club"
[*] NEW FEATURE* - Access World Campaign UI
[*] NEW FEATURE* - "Skip time" to next tournament match
[*] ADDED starting conditions difficulty "VERY EASY"
[*] ADDED starting conditions difficulty "EASY"
[*] ADDED starting conditions difficulty "NORMAL"
[*] ADDED starting conditions difficulty "HARD"
[*] ADDED "World Campaign" button in main club menu
[*] ADDED "Skip training" button in main club menu
[*] ADDED setting in options to limit refresh rate (vSync)
[*] REWORKED main club menu UI
[*] REWORKED World map UI
[*] REWORKED Club goals UI
[*] All menus now reopen club menu for smoother gameplay
[*] Moved close buttons more to the center in all menus
[*] Day text removed from Top UI
[*] News now reopen club menu 
[*] Club goals renamed to "Daily club report"
[*] Fixed issues with competitions triggers
[*] Fixed issues with next day not working correctly
[*] Fixed issues with triggers for world cup event
[*] Fixed issues with triggers for league event
[*] Updated several tooltips
[*] Numerous minor bug/grammar/graphics fixes
[*] Numerous stability fixes
[*] Savefiles from previous version are compatible
[/list]
[i]If you are stuck between competitions or have issues with tournament triggers we would recommend starting a new game to hopefully clear up any bugs that might have been solved in recent updates.

If you have any other issues with the game feel free to drop us a line on the Steam forums and we will take a look at it. [/i]

We hope you like these improvements.
Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Golden Goal Update (Version 1.08.367++)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/e0a0d2b172370b03c138b1663ab6cd53bd0daeae.png[/img]

Hello everyone! Here is a major update to Football School with even more fixes and improvements. We hope for a smoother experience with the improved gamemenu, faster loading times and the visual updates. The matches should be more exciting to watch with the golden goal overtime rule. Introducing players to the mechanics in the game has been one of our biggest challenges. Condition labs and intensity training are now unlocked in the beginning. We added tutorials regarding which attributes to focus on in the early game. We also added "Team learning" in competitions to make sure that players gain stats much faster. And much more. Enjoy!

[b]Here are the patch notes(v1.08.367++):[/b]
[list]
[*] Golden goal added to overtime (next goal wins the game)
[*] Added sandbox feature, play custom games with your own setup
[*] Reworked all arena pitch textures (it looks much nicer)
[*] Players now start with condition labs and intensity training
[*] Added visual feedback for total debt amount in finances
[*] Added option to pay off full loan amount in finances
[*] Added visual feedback in team coach for available player perks
[*] Added tutorial message to practice regarding kick training
[*] Added passive perk "team learning" to all competitions 
[*] Players now gains stat increase as reward from competitions
[*] 100% chance to gain stat bonus when tournament is finished
[*] Game menu will now auto roll up after closing another menu
[*] Starting perk "For the fans" now give club marketing rank3
[*] Starting perk "Skilled team" now gives starting players level3
[*] Starting perk "Good business" now gives clubshop2 (250 products)
[*] Added more sponsor events
[*] Added more fanclub events
[*] Added more clubshop events
[*] Added more staffhouse events
[*] Added more relax center events
[*] Added more media events
[*] Added more player boost events
[*] Added more staff recruitment events
[*] Added more striker coach events
[*] Added more midfielder coach events
[*] Added more defence coach events
[*] Added more scout events
[*] Added more promoter events
[*] Added more negotiator events
[*] Tweaks to famous players value gain
[*] Tweaks to transfer events
[*] Tweaks to contract negotiations
[*] Tweaks to team skill balance in all tournaments
[*] Tweaks to experience gain from practice
[*] Minor tweaks to condition gain for resting players
[*] Updated several tooltips
[*] Numerous minor bug/grammar/graphics fixes
[*] Savefiles from previous version are compatible
[/list]
